about: the choices hole's march is made of: how far a step goes, when a ray is given up, how near the singularity a falling body stops, and how far and how long a ray is marched to class it. picked, not derived and not measured: each was in libholemath at 7678944 and came into celestial with it, as it was. lengths are in M, the hole's mass. they are hole's own file, not celestial's research data, so that hole keeps to the standard library and can leave

choices.name: pace share
choices.says: a step of the march in the affine parameter, as a share of the radius it is taken at
choices.by: libholemath's march (7678944), carried as it was

choices.name: time share
choices.says: the time a step of the march spans, as a share of the radius it is taken at; at this, libholemath's own comment says, a march costs about what its earlier step of a fiftieth of the radius in the affine parameter did, and its worst ray lands several times nearer
choices.by: libholemath's march (7678944), carried as it was, comment and all

choices.name: hover ratio
choices.says: how many times its energy an arriving ray's time velocity is when the march gives it up as come from the horizon's edge
choices.by: libholemath's march (7678944), carried as it was

choices.name: turned back share
choices.says: how far above its least radius a ray has risen, as a share of it, when its closest approach takes it to be on its way out
choices.by: libholemath's march (7678944), carried as it was

choices.name: singularity margin
choices.says: how near the singularity, in M, a falling body is advanced before it stops; the pace goes to nought there
choices.by: libholemath's fall (7678944), carried as it was

choices.name: advance share
choices.says: the share of the pace a falling body is advanced by in a step of its proper time
choices.by: libholemath's fall (7678944), carried as it was

choices.name: far factor
choices.says: how many times its starting radius out a ray has got when it is classed as escaping
choices.by: libholemath's classifier (7678944), carried as it was

choices.name: far floor
choices.says: the least radius, in M, that counts as far for a ray classed as escaping that starts close in
choices.by: libholemath's classifier (7678944), carried as it was

choices.name: classify steps
choices.says: how many steps a ray is marched to class it; light from a hundred M falls in in about a hundred and thirty, and matter on a circle at ten M goes round seven times in this many
choices.by: libholemath's classifier (7678944), carried as it was
